info.cls_ename: Master's Program in Mechanical Engineering, Department of Mechanical and computer-Aided Engineering

description.describe_ch: 本課程配合本系以CAD、CAM與CAE為發展主軸，以塑膠射出機台之成型系統、鎖模系統與相關先進製程，導入實務操作技術、實機操作與機構設計等系統分析，培養學生俱備先進製程之設計、分析與建置等技術能力，使將來能為機台建置與模擬分析業者所需之專業技術人才。
description.describe_eh: This course supports department with the development of CAD, CAM, and CAE, and uses the plastic injection molding machine molding system, mold clamping system, and related advanced processes, and introduces system analysis of practical operation technology, actual machine operation, and mechanism design. The technical capabilities of design, analysis and construction of advanced manufacturing processes will enable us to build the professional technical talents required by machine building and simulation analysis operators in the future.

targets.describe_ch: 讓學生瞭解塑膠射出機台之成型系統與機構設計等理論分析。
targets.describe_en: Let students understand the theoretical analysis of the molding system and mechanism design of plastic injection machines.

targets.describe_ch: 應用結構力學、機構學與機動學等，提升機台結構設計與作動過程之效率。
targets.describe_en: Application of structural mechanics, mechanism and maneuverability to improve the efficiency of machine structure design and operation process.

targets.describe_ch: 整合數值模擬、力學理論和應用軟體，培養學生解決工程問題的能力。
targets.describe_en: Integrate numerical simulation, mechanics theory, and application software to cultivate students' ability on solving engineering problems.

targets.describe_ch: 使用機台結構設計與先進製程領域等相關製程設計、自我學習與問題解決之能力。
targets.describe_en: Use of machine structure design and advanced process areas and other related process design, self-learning and problem solving capabilities.

targets.describe_ch: 培育學生因應先進製造、製程與相關工程問題之能力。
targets.describe_en: Cultivate students' ability to respond to advanced manufacturing, process and related engineering issues.
